subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose Slack and Discord workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and what default-off gates, provider scopes, requester authorization, and gateway permission level should that surface require?
rationale: The feature would let agents mutate external workspace/server structure, and current main has no accepted Slack channel-management gate or cross-provider authority model for that capability.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Treat the open Discord CLI work as the only near-term path and defer Slack channel creation until the broader security model is accepted.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep workspace and server provisioning in provider-native admin tools or external scripts until stronger product demand or a safer extension boundary exists.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter wrote the prior detailed review and has the strongest combined signal across the issue discussion and current CLI/channel history.
